title: Braised Brussels Sprouts au Gratin
description: A French-inspired dish featuring tender Brussels sprouts in a rich, creamy sauce, topped with a crispy, golden-brown crust.
instructions: Trim the ends of the Brussels sprouts and halve them.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Brussels sprouts and cook until they begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the Brussels sprouts and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and heavy cream, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Gruyère cheese until melted and smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional Gruyère cheese.
Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake until golden brown and crispy, about 20-25 minutes.
